findings.text: The requested_effective_date was changed from 2026-12-01 to 2027-01-01 without any quoted supporting evidence in the timeline. The applied fix has empty evidence.

The election_type was changed from OEP to AEP based only on the received date, but the source document explicitly states 'Election: OEP'. There is no quoted evidence from the application supporting AEP; this is an inferred correction rather than a document-supported one.
The requested_effective_date was changed from 2026-12-01 to 2027-01-01 without any quoted supporting evidence in the record. The fix entry for this field has empty evidence.

The accepted outcome depends on changing election_type from OEP to AEP and requested_effective_date to 2027-01-01, but only the election_type change is tied to quoted evidence from the source text. There is no event with quoted evidence supporting the new effective date.

requested_effective_date was changed from 2026-12-01 to 2027-01-01 without any cited supporting evidence in the timeline. The fix record has an empty evidence field, so this change is not tied to quoted support.

election_type was changed from OEP to AEP based only on the election date and resolver diagnosis; there is no quoted evidence in the case documents supporting that the applicant selected AEP rather than OEP. The original submission/source text explicitly shows OEP.

The requested_effective_date was changed from 2026-11-01 to 2027-01-01 without any quoted documentary evidence in the fix record; the source form explicitly shows 2026-11-01, and seq 7884 lists empty evidence.

The case was accepted after altering the requested_effective_date based on resolver policy reasoning rather than documented evidence from the submitted materials. The acceptance depends on that unsupported change.
